// Samples for a curvature comb visualization of a planar curve. CombTips and
// CurvePoints are parallel arrays: each tip lies at the curve point offset along
// the normal by curvature times Scale (Scale is in squared world units, mapping
// reciprocal-world-unit curvature to a world-unit comb height).
type CurvatureComb2D
{
    CurvePoints: Array<Point2D>;
    CombTips: Array<Point2D>;
    Scale: Number;
}

//==
// # Differential geometry: surface points and curvature
//
// Evaluated points and tangent planes of parametric surfaces, the curvature
// summaries computed there, and the fundamental forms and intrinsic metric data
// that generate them. Curvatures are in reciprocal world units; form components
// are per squared parameter unit.

//==
// # ISurface point data

// An evaluated point of a parametric surface: position, unit normal, and the
// (generally non-unit) tangent partial derivatives at parameter Uv.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normal_(geometry))
type SurfacePoint3D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
    TangentU: Vector3D;
    TangentV: Vector3D;
    Uv: UvCoordinate;
}

// The tangent plane of a surface at a point, as an origin, two spanning tangent
// vectors (the partial derivatives, generally neither unit nor orthogonal), and
// the unit normal.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tangent_space)
type TangentSpace3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    TangentU: Vector3D;
    TangentV: Vector3D;
    Normal: Direction3D;
}

//==
// # Curvature of surfaces

// The two principal curvatures of a surface at a point (reciprocal world units,
// Minimum <= Maximum) and their orthogonal unit directions in the tangent plane.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principal_curvature)
type PrincipalCurvatures
    implements IValue
{
    Minimum: Number;
    Maximum: Number;
    MinimumDirection: Direction3D;
    MaximumDirection: Direction3D;
}

// Full curvature summary of a surface point. Gaussian is the product of the
// principal curvatures (reciprocal squared world units); Mean is their average
// (reciprocal world units).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaussian_curvature)
type SurfaceCurvature
    implements IValue
{
    Gaussian: Number;
    Mean: Number;
    Principal: PrincipalCurvatures;
}

// Local shape classification of a surface point by its principal
// curvatures: Gaussian curvature positive (Elliptic), exactly one zero
// principal curvature (Parabolic), Gaussian negative (Hyperbolic), both
// zero (Planar), or equal and nonzero (Umbilic).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Differential_geometry_of_surfaces)
type SurfacePointShape = Elliptic | Parabolic | Hyperbolic | Planar | Umbilic;

//==
// # Fundamental forms and intrinsic data

// The first fundamental form (intrinsic metric) of a surface at a point:
// E = dot(Xu, Xu), F = dot(Xu, Xv), G = dot(Xv, Xv). Units: squared world units
// per squared parameter unit.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_fundamental_form)
type FirstFundamentalForm
    implements IValue
{
    E: Number;
    F: Number;
    G: Number;
}

// The second fundamental form (extrinsic bending) of a surface at a point:
// L = dot(Xuu, n), M = dot(Xuv, n), N = dot(Xvv, n) with n the unit normal.
// Units: world units per squared parameter unit.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Second_fundamental_form)
type SecondFundamentalForm
    implements IValue
{
    L: Number;
    M: Number;
    N: Number;
}

// The shape (Weingarten) operator of a surface at a point, expressed as a 2x2
// matrix in the (Xu, Xv) tangent basis. Its eigenvalues are the principal
// curvatures; generally not symmetric in a non-orthonormal basis.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weingarten_equations)
type ShapeOperator2D
    implements IValue
{
    Matrix: Matrix2x2;
}

// A Riemannian metric evaluated at a point of a 2D parameter domain: the three
// unique components of a symmetric positive-definite 2x2 tensor. G12 = G21.
// Units: squared world units per squared parameter unit.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_tensor)
type RiemannianMetric2D
    implements IValue
{
    G11: Number;
    G12: Number;
    G22: Number;
}

// The Christoffel symbols of the second kind of a 2D metric at a point.
// Gamma-kij is written GammaKIJ: the first digit is the upper index, the last
// two the symmetric lower indices (GammaK12 = GammaK21). Units: reciprocal
// parameter units.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christoffel_symbols)
type ChristoffelSymbols2D
    implements IValue
{
    Gamma111: Number;
    Gamma112: Number;
    Gamma122: Number;
    Gamma211: Number;
    Gamma212: Number;
    Gamma222: Number;
}
